title: ETA / Unitas 6497-2 — Exploded Watch Anatomy
summary: A movement-first 3D explainer of a large hand-wound mechanical watch with causal winding and setting, stored reserve, an integrated balance/hairspring oscillator, and finite polygon escape-tooth / pallet-jewel contact governing lock, impulse, drop, capture and train release.

facts.Current pass: M5h finite tooth + pallet-jewel polygons → lock / impulse / drop / capture → Δω admission + train release
